ms.report:
We have successfully completed the milestone requirements. Below is a breakdown of deliverables and corresponding proof of work:
1. Adaptation of zkFetch for Cardano
・zkFetch has been modified to work with Cardano’s EUTxO model.
・A Cardano-specific implementation is provided to store zkProof identifiers and associated real-world data on-chain.
・Relevant scripts:
・createWallet.ts – Generates a Cardano wallet using Deno.
・sendTransaction.ts – Submits a transaction embedding zkProof metadata to the Cardano blockchain.

Proof: GitHub Repository – zkFetch for Cardano
2. Development and Deployment of Modules
・Developed both off-chain (wallet creation, proof request) and on-chain (metadata inclusion in Cardano transactions) modules.
・Demonstrated ability to publish zkProof data to Cardano via transaction metadata.

Example transaction: Metadata Explorer (Cardano Preprod)
3. Integration with Data Providers
・Integrated two real-world data providers using zkFetch:
・Live ADA price fetched from a public API.
・Sports match scores scraped from Goal.com using regex-based proof schema.

Proof files:
・proof.json – Stores generated zkProof data.
・requestProof.js – Requests proof from external data APIs.
・Regex-based integration shown in README and script examples.

4. Demonstration of Capabilities
・Full working prototype showcasing the process:
・Wallet creation
・zkProof generation from an external API
・Cardano transaction submission with zkProof metadata
・Demo Video : https://www.loom.com/share/8fe127ab170a45a49711af4e42167ff9?sid=0ac14421-7db5-4785-80c5-3c8acc25aaf6

Steps documented in README
Codebase fully available in public GitHub repository.
